main_text.p: דְּכוֹרָא Ch. Idem. Plural. דְּכוּרִין, דְּכוּרָיָא.

דְּכְרָנָא, דְּכְרָנָא, דּוּכְרָן דְּכְרָן Ch. & Syr. Memoria, memoriale, monumentum. Plur. דְּכְרָנִין, דְּכְרָנָיָא, Memorialia: Res memorabiles. Esr.4.15. סִפְרָא דְּכְרָנָיָא Liber memoriarum, sive rerum memorabilium, Esth.6.1. מַמְנָא עַל דְּכְרָנָיָא Praefectus à monimentis, A'commentariis, Hebr. מַזְכִּיר, 2.Sam.8.16.
דְּכוֹרוּ Ch. Ariolus, Pytho. Hebr. יִדְּעֹנִי. Plur. דְּכוּרִין.
דלא דְּלִי, דְּלָה Ch. & Syr. Haurire, exhaurire: Item Levare, elevare, efferre, evehere, ut Hebr. Aff. Græc. Ἀντλέω.
דלב דְּלוּב Ch. Castanea arbor, juxta quosdam. Juxta alios, Platanus, Genef.30.37. in Onkelo. Et sic quoq; Druf. quem vide in Comment. ad hunc locum.
דלג Hebr. Subsiliit, insiliit. Hinc Ch. ex Pahel וּדְלָגְיָה Et exilire fecit eum, Genef.41.14. in Targ. Jonath. h. e. eduxit eum ex carcere.

דלה Ch. Pavere, expavescere, timere, formidare: Idem quod דָּחַל. Item Haurire, exhaurire, Jesa.30.14. & sic idem quod דְּלָה. Syris significat transitive, Turbare, conturbare, perturbare, terrere. Pahel דַּלַּה דְּלָּה Pavere fecit, terruit, turbavit, coturbavit. Aphel אַדְלִיהַ Idem. Ex Ethpah. ܐܬܕܠܝ Turbati sunt, Act.17.8.
דְּלוּחָא, דְּלוּחְיָא, דְּלוּחָא Ch. Timor, pavor, formido. Syr. ܕܠܘܚܐ Ibi etiam est pavor, sive trepidatio, conturbatio, inconstantia, Jacobi 3.16.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic/Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words are reproduced as far as legible; the Hebrew vowel points and small marks in the scan are approximate. The catchword "Plu-" at the foot is a hyphenated line-end word, not a catchword in the strict sense; it is kept in the text. Several Hebrew/Syriac forms are uncertain and should be checked against the original.
